expected_root_cause: Packets on the order-service to product-service network path were dropped while other paths remained healthy.
expected_symptoms: Calls from order-service to product-service time out.
Direct product-service health and unrelated user-service communication remain successful.
expected_evidence: order-service logs contain product-service timeout or connection failure messages.
Prometheus HTTP 5xx counters increase for order creation while product-service remains healthy.
Jaeger traces show successful user-service spans followed by a timed-out product-service client span.
Direct product-service requests remain successful throughout the incident.
expected_resolution: Restore transport on the affected dependency path, then verify dependency connectivity and error rates recover.

timeline.event: Capture normal order-service dependency connectivity and error rate.
Drop packets only from order-service to product-service.
Product dependency calls time out while unrelated network paths remain healthy.
Remove the network rules and confirm dependency calls and traces recover.
